confirmed_natural_hit: An archived business sequence needs the earlier capture and later explicit tight-directory request for the task, independently of this optimization plan or a compatibility-only regression.
Original input, request order, actual successful route, installed/loaded source and uninterrupted host lifetime are bound.

Runtime object incarnation and retained per-object resource continuity are established. Current stamp and evaluated matrix/scale compatibility are directly observed or conservatively reconstructed from the bound source and complete unchanged static-host trace.
The actual directory packet has cache_hit=false. Existing directory-cache hits remove the proposed work already.
Removable work is attributable to the current directory miss. A complete business window exists before selecting a performance candidate.
confirmed_non_hit: A successful actual tight-directory packet reports cache_hit=true.
A complete trace proves no later tight-directory request, or proves current selected-object resources absent/incompatible.
The only directory request is a predeclared compatibility control with no task requirement. This excludes natural eligibility while preserving technical mechanism evidence.
eligibility_rules.not_actionable: The bounded audit establishes zero qualified natural hits. Remaining unknowns do not authorize enlarging search or constructing a natural consumer. This is a decision within this batch, not proof that real workloads can never hit.
unknown: Missing original arguments, incomplete route, missing host/generation continuity, missing object/resource binding, or unobserved stamp/pose change.
Only same PID, same public scene revision/fingerprint, unchanged directory digest, positive aggregate resource count or receiver decoder baseline is available.
A partial archive search finds no explicit directory text but excludes binary RPCs and arbitrary code-string requests.
A source-derived operation count has no elapsed whole-task measurement. Cost benefit stays unknown.

known_controls.fake_host: test_directory.py validates tight/fresh facts, invalidation, no-hooks behavior, directory-first followed by selected capture, and full→directory decoder independence. Fake host counts demonstrate reachable code behavior, not real task demand or time.
known_controls.wire_meter: host_work records module, generation, aggregate counters and per-runtime-key resource revision/array lengths. It omits stamp, evaluated matrix, pose and mesh existence, and omits id(host) from serialized output. Pair with original source-bound RPC and continuous generation rather than equating module or aggregate count to current compatibility.

candidate_constraints_if_later_authorize: Retain the original directory triangle upper bound max(0,len(loops)-2*len(polygons)) as source-derived metadata. Actual triangulated face count is not an equivalent admission budget.
Prepared-local resources lacking this original count take the existing directory read path.
Reuse world vertices for tight min/max with original finite, budget and deadline checks. Count min/max visits separately and do not build full mesh resources on cold directory.
Keep directory packet, sender resources and receiver decoder baselines as distinct ownership contracts.
false_negative_guards: Directory miss is the operational condition. First-ever directory is narrower, because capture-cap eviction or non-geometric invalidation can remove the directory packet while retaining compatible resources. Preserve the current frozen first-directory domain and label these later-miss opportunities separately.
Same resource may remain compatible across a scene-residency revision change. Exact revision equality is sufficient continuity evidence in supported static traces, not a mandatory reuse predicate.
A new connector may retain the same Blender resident host. Resolve actual module/tag/token continuity.
Insufficient source/resource/pose data stays unknown rather than confirmed miss.
JSON-only no-occurrence inventories cannot exclude all low-level binary/code-string traffic.
false_positive_guards: Do not count old overview/task_overview labels as a tight-directory call.
Do not promote HARNESS_PROTOCOL old_readonly_regression to natural demand.
Do not treat CAPTURE_REPLAY, fake hosts or programmed warm-up as real demand.
Do not claim measured counts or timing from source-derived branch counts.
Do not use 2221 files, catalogue occurrences or repeated copies as independent task denominators.
plan_review.judgment: The bounded natural-demand gate and not_actionable exit are appropriate. The technical duplicate remains a valid source opportunity.

preparation_events.scope: A static JSON metadata script piped to python and a print-only python check resolved to WindowsApps aliases. No product was imported and no metadata output was produced. Reports use the explicit runtime below.

real_host_technical_example.classification: technical duplicate mechanism evidenced, compatibility-only sequence, natural task eligibility not met
not_directly_observed: private resource stamp at directory entry
private current resource pose at directory entry
marginal elapsed time removed by reuse

directory_work.provenance: deterministic complete directory-miss branch in source, not runtime instrumentation

source_derived_inference.host: Both adjacent successful SCRIPT.py requests reuse the same sys.modules resident slot/tag and _mcp_resident_host.
source_derived_inference.resource: The prior delta serializes actual host-owned resource29. No intervening control is present. Static rigid unchanged generation and source invalidation logic support retained stamp/pose compatibility.

source_findings.finding: capture_directory obtains current graph, objects and residency, checks the directory selection cache, then unconditionally to_mesh and world-forwards every evaluated vertex on miss. The complete packet is cached only after successful construction.

Resident resources are created by _resident_capture through full/task/acquisition captures. They retain vertices_local, faces, edges, stamp, world mesh and pose=(evaluated matrix, scale). Directory capture does not create mesh resources or decoder baselines.

The reusable predicate needs enabled residency, current runtime-object key, a retained resource, exact current _resource_stamp, exact evaluated matrix/scale pose and materialized finite world vertices. Aggregate resident_resources>0 cannot prove this per object.

Context reset and undo/redo/load clear resources. Signature or depsgraph serial changes clear captures/nearest while retaining still-live resources. Resource-budget eviction clears captures and may evict relevant objects. The eight-entry capture cap can clear directory entries while retaining resource arrays.

BlenderMCPHost uses a project-root-derived sys.modules slot and source/helper/expert-derived resident tag. Matching module/tag reuses _mcp_resident_host even through a newly constructed connector. Different source/root or missing module changes this relation. The owned typed worker constructs one host before its dispatch loop.

to_mesh counts resident/directory expansions. directory_vertices counts directory world-forwarded vertices. world_transforms and world_vertices_transformed count resource world rebuilds. Legacy counters do not count the still-required tight-min/max visits separately.

measurement/sample.py old lane calls query.mode=overview and extracts routing.context_text objects as directory_facts. This old full-capture overview is not a capture_directory invocation. The new lane calls mode=directory. Both are identified from actual arguments and response schema, not directory_facts labels.

supporting_context_inventory.denominator_unit: files and JSON occurrences, not independent tasks
supporting_context_inventory.limitation: Only JSON/JSONL and JSON-looking embedded strings were inspected. SCRIPT.py, binary transports and arbitrary execute_code strings are outside this inventory.
